answer.content:
I'm really sorry to hear the tablet turned up missing — that's a frustrating situation. Unfortunately, I have to be upfront with you: I'm not able to issue a refund or place a reorder for an item that shows as delivered but was lost. The return process I can offer only works when the physical item can be sent back, and I'm not able to place new orders on your behalf.

Since a lost-item claim is outside what I can do with my tools, I can transfer you to a human agent who may be able to assist further with this. Would you like me to do that?
